evidence: Scope: everything the agent can read - instruction.md plus the two notes COPYed to /instructions (environment/Dockerfile:14-16) and the seed. (1) The skill's check-5 grep `judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel` (case-insensitive) over task/instruction.md and task/environment/instructions/*.md returned zero matches (grep rc=1); the same vocabulary plus grader/probe over seed_data.json returned none. (2) A wider word scan (grader, grading, scor*, verifier, canary, gate, polish, likert, evaluat*, checker, test, oracle, golden, benchmark, points, /logs, harbor, probe, rewardkit, openrouter, mcp, restart_app, submitted, visual, functional) hit only product language, each read in context: hireops_rules.md:60 'there is no test clock to wind forward'; :77 'basis points'; :171 'The budget gate: an offer's committed run-rate ... must fit inside the requisition's remaining headroom'; :239 'resubmitted exactly'; :524 'by the same test commit applies in section 11'; :63/:71/:79/:291/:517 'point'. None names the judge, rubric, a dimension (functional/polish/visual/render/constraints do not occur), a weight, a test path or a sentinel. (3) All 164 [[criterion]] blocks parsed from the five judge.toml files: no criterion id (verbatim or with underscores as spaces) and no criterion name occurs in the brief or notes. (4) Probe literals: of 189 quoted literals in the judge prompts/criteria/app_context, the only ones also present in the brief/notes are the seven demo emails and the password `Hireops!2026`, which the skill profile expects (SKILL.md:66). Judge-side tokens such as 'judge-created', 'gate-setup', APP_RESTART_HELPER are absent from brief, notes and seed. (5) Verbatim overlap: longest shared word run between brief/notes and all tests text is 9 words ('the offending field when the explanation sits at that', hireops_rules.md:557-558), a single ordinary product sentence, not a lifted criterion; no other run of 8+ words. (6) Residual observation, not a defect under this row: hireops_rules.md:417-422 ('runs as an unprivileged user and may launch a writable copy of the submitted application ... The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH') and integration.md:16-19 ('For delivery, use ordinary files under /app. Symbolic links are supported only inside /app/node_modules') describe launch conditions that mirror the verifier entrypoint. They name no judge, rubric, dimension, weight, test path or sentinel, and quality checks 4 and 23 plus check-runtime-contract-strings.py require the injected environment variables to be stated where the agent can read them, so this is runtime contract rather than grader machinery; 'submitted application/entry' is the nearest the notes come to acknowledging evaluation. Adversarial reading: a broken app gains nothing from the brief because no probe value, criterion id or scoring structure is disclosed; a conforming alternative is not disadvantaged by this row. Limits: check-instruction-hygiene.py itself was not executed (not available here); its documented behaviour was applied by hand, which is not a portal checker run. No runtime run bears on this row.
